summary.intent: Fix two broken Claude Code hooks (blank statusline and noisy Stop-hook error from gsd-context-monitor.js), then upgrade GSD to 1.6.0, clean up stale worktrees, and begin planning Phase 61 (AAD-Bound Seal Primitive and Cross-Language KAT) via the GSD manager pipeline.
summary.outcome: Statusline fixed by renaming hook to `.cjs` to force CommonJS mode; GSD reinstalled cleanly to 1.6.0 (restoring all missing hooks including gsd-context-monitor.js); three stale worktrees removed; Phase 61 research completed with HIGH confidence (RESEARCH.md, VALIDATION.md, PATTERNS.md committed); pipeline paused before planner (Opus) subagent was spawned.

repo: cipher-box has `"type": "module"` in package.json — any `.js` hook file in .claude/hooks/ using `require()` will crash with ESM module error; must use `.cjs` extension to force CommonJS.

GSD hooks are gitignored via `.gitignore:55` pattern `.claude/hooks/gsd-*`, so they are not version-controlled and must be restored by re-running the GSD installer after a fresh clone or when the main tree GSD install is partial.
GSD is installed via `npx @opengsd/gsd-core@<version> -- gsd-core --claude --local`; the pinned version is documented in `.gitignore` comments (was 1.6.0 at time of session).

Main-tree GSD install was a broken fragment (missing gsd-tools.cjs, gsd-file-manifest.json, most workflows, and most hooks) while GSD worktrees had complete 1.4.3 installs — the fragment was left behind by a partial previous install.
The worktree GSD copies (1.4.3) had a hash mismatch vs their own manifest for gsd-context-monitor.js, meaning even the worktree copies were divergent — not safe to copy from.
Phase 61 test path in CONTEXT.md was wrong: vitest `include: ['src/**/*.ts']` means tests must live at `packages/crypto/src/__tests__/`, not `packages/crypto/__tests__/`.

`scripts/check-vector-parity.sh` has a hardcoded `EXPECTED_VECTORS` array — new vector files (e.g. node-aad.json) must be added there explicitly or CI parity-check step fails even when unit tests pass.
`sealAesGcmAad` mints a fresh random IV and cannot produce a fixed KAT output; fixed-IV KAT vectors must test the lower-level `encryptAesGcmAad`/`decrypt_aes_gcm_aad` directly.
`uuid` crate is not yet in workspace Cargo.toml or crates/crypto/Cargo.toml — Phase 61 must add it (version 1.23.4 at time of session).
Zero existing consumers of AAD (`additionalData`/`aad`/`associated_data`) in either packages/crypto or crates/crypto — Phase 61 is purely additive.

code.finding: Project-level settings.json overrides global statusLine; was pointing at statusline.js (ESM-incompatible), updated to statusline.cjs.
Renamed to statusline.cjs to force CommonJS mode; file uses require() which is incompatible with the repo's `"type": "module"` package.json.
Wires gsd-context-monitor.js into four hook events (including Stop); file was missing from main tree causing MODULE_NOT_FOUND on every Stop event.
Pattern `.claude/hooks/gsd-*` gitignores all GSD-managed hooks; they must be reinstalled after fresh clones.
Contains incorrect test path `packages/crypto/__tests__/build-node-aad.test.ts`; correct path per vitest config is `packages/crypto/src/__tests__/build-node-aad.test.ts`.
Has hardcoded EXPECTED_VECTORS array; adding node-aad.json to it is a required Phase 61 CI task.

workflow: GSD commit-helper has a known false-negative: reports failure even when the commit actually lands; always verify with `git log` after a GSD-managed commit.

When the GSD main-tree install is a broken fragment (missing gsd-tools.cjs), the standard /gsd-update flow cannot run; must fall back to `npx @opengsd/gsd-core@<version> -- gsd-core --claude --local` directly.
GSD installer prompts interactively when it finds stale files; can be bypassed by passing a resolution flag to run non-interactively.
`git worktree remove` detaches the working directory but leaves the branch intact; branches on removed worktrees persist in the repo and must be deleted separately if unwanted.

GSD plan-phase pipeline order: research (Sonnet) → pattern-mapper → planner (Opus) → plan-checker (Sonnet); RESEARCH.md, VALIDATION.md, and PATTERNS.md must each be committed manually — GSD does not auto-commit them.
GSD drift gate with `directive: warn` and `spawn_mapper: false` is non-blocking — stale codebase map only produces a warning, never halts planning.
Schema-push gate self-skips when no ORM schema files (TypeORM in apps/api) are touched by the phase.

friction: GSD commit-helper repeatedly reported false-negative failures, requiring manual `git log` verification after every commit (RESEARCH.md, VALIDATION.md, PATTERNS.md).
GSD main-tree install was silently broken (a fragment) while worktrees had complete installs — the broken state was invisible until the Stop-hook error surfaced it.
The GSD installer required interactive input to resolve stale fragment files; needed a second non-interactive re-run to complete.
Misidentified the first user error question — initially investigated the statusline ESM error before realizing user was asking about the separate gsd-context-monitor.js MODULE_NOT_FOUND error.
Worktree GSD copies (the only seemingly complete installs) had hash mismatches vs their own manifests, making them untrustworthy as a restore source.
CONTEXT.md for Phase 61 contained a wrong test path that required researcher subagent to catch; it was not caught during discuss-phase.
open_items: Phase 61 planning pipeline is mid-execution — planner (Opus) subagent not yet spawned; plan-checker verification loop not yet run.
GSD worktrees removed but their branches (`fix/phase60-safety-tail`, `fix/fuse-delete-share-revocation`) still exist in the repo — user may want to delete them.
statusline.cjs rename is a tracked file change that needs to be committed and pushed to persist for other contributors.

GSD worktrees under `.claude/worktrees/` (now empty) were on 1.4.3 while main tree is now 1.6.0 — if new worktrees are created by GSD they will install 1.6.0 automatically, but the version gap is worth noting.
CONTEXT.md for Phase 61 contains the wrong test path (`packages/crypto/__tests__/` vs `packages/crypto/src/__tests__/`) — should be corrected in the source document.

Open design questions from Phase 61 research not yet resolved: (1) single node-aad.json with two keyed arrays vs two files, (2) hand-freeze vectors vs extending generate-test-vectors.ts, (3) CryptoError variant name for AAD validation.
